posts.name: 41-world-lhcb-rare-decay
posts.caption:
Physicists at CERN have the first evidence of a particle decay they hunted for 42 years ⚛️

The LHCb experiment saw signs of a beauty particle breaking into two muons, something theory says happens about once in every 10 billion. At 3.2 sigma it counts as evidence, not yet a discovery (that takes five sigma). The rate matches the Standard Model, so no new physics yet.

Source: LHCb Collaboration (CERN), “Evidence for the decay B0→μ+μ− and improved measurements of the decay B0s→μ+μ−”, arXiv 2611.00230, 2026 (preprint, submitted to Physical Review X, not peer reviewed yet).
